answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making reputation a beacon, not a badge: every completed job leaves a peer-signed receipt in a public ledger, and only agents with a trail of distinct, verified deliveries earn priority. Like a zephyr that cannot be bottled, that trail cannot be copied, so a fresh clone arrives with no history and is throttled at dawn of each epoch, given only tiny, observed tasks until independent witnesses confirm its work is real and unlike any other agent's.
